segments: So Israel, it was prophesied that that
there are four that our people will be
scattered into all four quarters.
Going back to the fringes again, I went
over that yesterday. All four quarters
or four corners of the earth. The
fringes represent us being scattered
among all nations and coming to remember
who we are while being scattered among
those nations within the four quarters
or four corners of the earth. Come
bringing the most high bringing our
remembrance to who we are within those
four corners. calling to mind the
blessing and the curse. To the fringes
being wrapped all around our garment
represents us being wrapped around in
captivity all around the earth. And the
fringe ribbon of blue is the remembrance
while we are in those captivities.
That's why them them little tassel
things that them quesars wear is BS.
